services.name: Private Events
services.desc: From intimate corporate dinners to epic birthday celebrations, Shrine Social Club is one of Boise’s most sought-after private event venues. From its early years as a gathering space for the El Korah Shriners to Duck Club’s back-to-back nights of live music, every event becomes unforgettable at the Shrine! Shrine Social Club offers fully-private event spaces in downtown Boise, Idaho - perfect for groups of all sizes. Whether you’re hosting 200 guests or upwards of 750, Shrine Social Club can fit your vision. Shrine Social Club in Boise is the go-to destination for private events across every category. services.name: Late Nite Karaoke at Shrine
services.desc: Warm up those vocal cords and bring your funnest friends-Late Nite Karaoke takes over the Shrine Social Club Basement every Wednesday night from 10pm-2am. Whether you’re a shower-singer superstar or a first-time mic grabber, this weekly karaoke party is all about big energy, loud choruses, and zero judgment. Late Nite Karaoke is your midweek excuse to stay out late and sing it out. The basement at Shrine Social Club sets the vibe with an intimate, underground feel that makes every performance feel like a headlining set.
